capabilities: Import local images and attachments into Eagle while preserving references in notes
Serve and display Eagle assets in notes, canvases, and cloud mode
Synchronize Obsidian tags and folder structure to Eagle assets
Locate, filter, and manage referenced and unreferenced assets from sidebars
Export notes as share packages, ZIP files, or folders
disambiguation: Not a vault synchronization tool; it leaves vault syncing to Obsidian Sync, Remotely Save, or similar.
extras: Not yet in the official community plugin directory; installed from GitHub releases or BRAT. Cloud mode is read-only, and imported attachment references cannot be restored automatically. Primarily tested on Windows and Android.
intentEvidence: Parts of OE Link's workflows and interface design were inspired by the following community projects
problem: Large numbers of attachments bloat an Obsidian vault and its synchronization, and Obsidian has no built-in way to manage media in an external asset library like Eagle.

relations.evidence: OE Link provides a stable workflow for referencing, importing, and managing assets between Obsidian and Eagle.
